expectations.text: Chooses a PlayMode test because the behavior depends on MonoBehaviour/Rigidbody physics across frames
expectations.evidence: Response states: 'anything that requires MonoBehaviour lifecycle or physics frames goes in a PlayMode test written as a [UnityTest] coroutine.' and the decision table shows 'Physics engine (Rigidbody, AddForce): Not active [EditMode] vs Active [PlayMode]'.

expectations.text: Uses [UnityTest] with an IEnumerator return type and yields frames (e.g., WaitForFixedUpdate or yield return null) before asserting
expectations.evidence: '[UnityTest] public IEnumerator Jump_MovesPlayerUpward_OverPhysicsFrames()' — uses [UnityTest], returns IEnumerator, and yields both 'yield return null' (to allow Awake to run) and 'yield return new WaitForFixedUpdate()' twice before the Assert.

expectations.text: Places the test in a PlayMode test assembly (.asmdef) separate from EditMode tests
expectations.evidence: PlayModeTests.asmdef is created at 'Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/PlayModeTests.asmdef' with no 'includePlatforms' restriction (unlike EditMode which restricts to Editor). It is a separate file from any EditMode asmdef.

expectations.text: Asserts the upward movement with NUnit constraint syntax (e.g., Is.GreaterThan on the y position or velocity)
expectations.evidence: 'Assert.That(go.transform.position.y, Is.GreaterThan(startY), "PlayerController.Jump() should move the Rigidbody upward.")' — uses NUnit constraint syntax Is.GreaterThan on the y-position, exactly matching the example given in the assertion.

expectations.text: Destroys spawned GameObjects at the end of the test so tests remain independent
expectations.evidence:
'// Cleanup
Object.Destroy(go);' appears at the end of the test method body. The response's design notes also explain: 'Keeps tests independent — the spawned GameObject is removed before the next test runs.'

expectations.text: Mentions running the suite via batchmode with -testPlatform PlayMode
expectations.evidence: Shows: 'python3 scripts/run_unity_tests.py --project-path /path/to/your/unity/project --test-platform PlayMode' and the underlying command including '-testPlatform PlayMode -testResults /tmp/results-playmode.xml -logFile -'. Both the script and raw batchmode flags are present.
